heroIntro: Welcome, I am David Billington. I am available online and face to face in Horndean, Hampshire. I provide a safe place where you can confidentially share your life, your story and what may be painful and confusing for you. Together, we can share your burden and find a new way of being. You can make incredible changes and empower yourself to take the right path for you.
aboutText: I run a private practice online and in person from Horndean, Hampshire, and I work for I’m All Ears counselling service in Surrey. I am a registered member of the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP) and follow its ethical framework for good practice.
supportIntro: I work with adults aged 18 and over on:
approachText: Everyone experiences challenges, and sometimes we need additional support to navigate and overcome them. As a trained psychotherapist, I offer a professional and skilled approach through self-exploration and discovery within the therapeutic relationship. My goal is to help you explore and understand your thoughts, feelings and behaviours to promote healing and growth.
introText: Before our first session, I offer a free 20-minute phone call to discuss what you need and answer any questions. If you decide to continue, we will arrange weekly 50-minute sessions at a regular time and review our progress together. Sessions are available online, by phone or face to face.
availability: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, including evenings
contactText: You may know what you need, or you may not. Perhaps you need a chat, a few sessions or longer-term help. Drop me a message and I can be here for you.
location: Horndean, Hampshire · online across the UK
sectionIntro: If you are considering counselling, you may be taking the first steps towards addressing a problem or discomfort in your life. Something may not be working for you, or you may feel unsure or distressed without knowing why.
practiceDetails: Face-to-face sessions take place in a private, confidential home setting. There is on-street parking and a bus stop about two minutes’ walk away. Online sessions are available if you prefer to speak from a familiar space.
blogIntro: A little space to explore counselling, neurodiversity and the things we carry.
